rule: 274 windows on 195 of the 196 videos in the development half of our split of the UAV-Anti-UAV test set. The other 224 test videos are kept untouched for one final test. UAV-Anti-UAV_Test_000316 is left out because its label files have fewer lines than it has frames. Window 'first': frames 4 to 163, or to the video's end. Window 'absence', in 79 videos: the longest labelled-absent run of at least 10 frames that starts at frame 204 or later, from 40 frames before it, for 160 frames or to the video's end.
labels: Line i of groundtruth_rect.txt and absent.txt labels frame i (counting from 0). An absent frame counts as a frame with no drone. A present frame whose box has no width or height is skipped.
videos_folder: the unpacked Test folder, with one subfolder per video holding the video, groundtruth_rect.txt and absent.txt
